name: zinput_mouse_wait_for_button_press
description: zInput::Mouse_WaitForButtonPress polls mouse input until a held button transition is found, resets transition state after each scan, and returns the 1-based button slot or zero for non-blocking calls.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x470680 passed for zinput_mouse_poll_wait with VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4 /FAcs and zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x470680 calls Mouse_PollState with dispatchCallbacks=true each iteration, scans mouse buttons 1 through 3, accepts Mouse_GetButtonTransitionState(button) == 2, calls Mouse_ResetTransitionState after each scan, repeats only when pollUntilFound is nonzero, and returns the matching 1-based button slot or zero.
Native smoke zinput_mouse_poll_state_smoke installs fake mouse device state and verifies Mouse_WaitForButtonPress(0) returns the expected 1-based mouse button after polling and computing transitions.
